title: Monitor running processes with htop
summary: htop is an interactive terminal tool that shows a live list of running processes, CPU and memory usage. It is easier to read and navigate than the classic top command.

steps.explain: Start htop to open the interactive process monitor.
steps.expect: A full-screen interface showing CPU, memory, and a list of processes.

alternatives.explain: Start htop in read-only mode, disabling all features that can change system or process settings.
Start htop showing only processes owned by a specific user.

placeholders.name: USERNAME
placeholders.description: The username whose processes to display

alternatives.explain: Start htop with a tree view to show parent-child relationships between processes.
Start htop sorted by a specific item (e.g., CPU, MEM).
